coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Axis of revolution is the primary machining axis. Section view depicts it along X with radial directions along Y; isometric note referenced Z as primary. For quoting and setup we treat X as the primary spindle axis.

features.name: Overall Part Body
features.description: Cylindrical plug or cap featuring an outer raised rim and a recessed flat central face with multiple through-holes.

features.name: Outer threaded surface
features.description: The outermost cylindrical profile of the plug, featuring an external thread.

features.name: Main internal recess
features.description: The large stepped counterbore opening to the right face.

features.name: Through holes
features.description: Four equally spaced through holes located on a pitch circle, with entry chamfers on the left face.

features.name: Central plate
features.description: The solid material thickness between the left outer face and the inner recess face.

features.name: Outer edge chamfer
features.description: Chamfer on the top and bottom outer edges of the right face.

relationships.detail: Internal recess shares the part’s rotational axis with the external thread.
Hole pattern axis is aligned with the main axis of the externally threaded body.
Outer edge chamfers are on the circumference of the same outer cylindrical surface as the external thread.
Central plate (web) faces are normal to the cylinder axis shown in section.
Through holes pass through the central plate thickness.
PCD 22 < Ø26 recess indicates the through holes open into the counterbore volume.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: No datum features defined in provided sections.

feature_graph.part_notes: Material: AL 6061-T6510, ACC. TO ASTM B-221.. Material standard: ASTM B-221. Heat treatment: none specified. DEBURR: EDGES R0.5 MAX OR CHAMFER 0.5X45° MAX. PROCESS: INSIDE CORNERS R0.25 MAX. FINISH: General surface finish: 125.

clarifications.question: Please confirm the geometry of the tapered transition between the Ø26 straight bore and the inner flat face on the internal recess (feature F2): provide the taper angle/length or specify if it should be a simple chamfer or fillet.
clarifications.suggested_default: If unspecified, treat as a 0.5 × 45° chamfer to match other chamfer conventions on the drawing.

assumptions.text: The isometric_view:F1 part_body is an overall depiction only and is not grouped with any specific feature; all individual machinable features are taken from main_cross_section.
Primary machining axis set to X based on the section view orientation, despite the isometric note referencing Z as primary.
